title: Reset a forgotten or expired password
steps: Open the self-service password portal in your browser from any device.
Choose Forgot password and enter your work email address.
Verify your identity with the authenticator app or the phone number registered on your account.
Create a new password that meets the company policy (at least 14 characters and not reused).
Sign in again on your laptop and phone, and update the saved password in any app that stores it.

title: Unlock an account after failed sign-ins
steps: Wait 15 minutes; most lockouts clear automatically.
If the account is still locked, use the Unlock account option in the self-service portal.
Verify your identity with the authenticator app registered on your account.
Check for old saved sign-ins on your phone mail app or mapped drives that keep retrying, then update or remove them.
If the account stays locked, reply to the ticket so the service desk can review it.

title: VPN: authentication failed
steps: Check that your network password is current by signing in to webmail; if that fails, follow the password reset article first.
Fully close the VPN client and open it again.
Confirm the clock and time zone on your laptop are set to automatic.
Disconnect any personal VPN or proxy tool, then connect again using the Corporate profile.
If the client still reports authentication failed, update the VPN client from Software Center and try again.

title: VPN connects but internal sites are unreachable
steps: Disconnect and reconnect to the Corporate VPN profile.
Clear the DNS cache (on Windows, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns).
Try opening the internal site by its full internal address instead of a short name.
Turn off any personal VPN or secure-DNS setting in your browser.
If only some sites fail, list the site names in the ticket so the service desk can check them.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
steps: Forget the Wi-Fi network and reconnect using your company sign-in.
Restart the laptop to refresh the wireless adapter.
Move closer to an access point and avoid the guest network.
Install any wireless driver update listed in Software Center.
If drops continue, note the time and location of each drop in the ticket.

title: Install approved software from Software Center
steps: Open Software Center from the Start menu (Windows) or Self Service (Mac).
Search for the application by name.
Select Install and wait until the status shows Installed.
Restart the application or the laptop if you are prompted to.
If the application is not listed, it is not on the approved list; reply with the business reason so the service desk can review it.

title: Outlook stuck syncing or in Send/Receive
steps: Check the status bar at the bottom of Outlook; if it says Working Offline, select Send/Receive and turn Work Offline off.
Close Outlook completely and open it again.
Check that you can open your mail in the web browser; if you can, your mailbox itself is fine.
Restart your laptop and open Outlook again.
If the problem remains, create a new Outlook profile from Control Panel under Mail.

title: Calendar invites are not showing
steps: Check the Junk and Deleted Items folders for the invite.
In Calendar, make sure the shared or secondary calendars you need are ticked.
Ask the organizer to resend the invite.
Check that your calendar view is not filtered by a category.
If invites from one person never arrive, add that person's name to the ticket.

title: Laptop will not power on or charge
steps: Check the power adapter is firmly plugged in at the wall and at the laptop, and try a different wall socket.
Unplug the adapter, hold the power button for 30 seconds, plug the adapter back in and press the power button once.
Remove any docking station and USB devices and try again.
Look at the lights on the adapter and laptop and note whether any light blinks.
If there is still no power, reply with the laptop asset tag and the light behaviour so the service desk can arrange a replacement.

title: Printer offline or add a network printer
steps: Check that the printer shows ready on its own screen and has paper.
On your laptop open Settings, then Printers and scanners, remove the printer and add it again from the list of company printers.
Clear stuck jobs from the print queue and print a test page.
Restart the printer if it still shows offline.
If it is still offline, reply with the printer name shown on its label.

title: Request standard access to a shared drive or tool
steps: Confirm the exact name of the shared drive, project or tool you need.
Submit a ticket naming the resource and the reason you need it.
Standard resources that match your role are approved automatically; others go to your manager or the resource owner.
Access normally appears within 15 minutes of approval; sign out and back in to refresh it.
Restricted and privileged resources always need a manual approval.

title: Report a suspected phishing email
steps: Do not click links, open attachments or reply to the message.
Use the Report phishing button in your mail client to send it to the security team.
Do not forward the message to colleagues.
If you already clicked a link or entered your credentials, tell the service desk immediately by phone or ticket.
The security team will contact you if more action is needed.
